subject: [hw] DEC06 -> DEC05/mm21: adapter is in and compile-checked; two protocol questions (first slice, FLUSH re-header) + crop origin
body:
DEC06 DONE (2124/2124). I integrated your client as the product seam, thanks - the API fits.

What I did:
- vt/dec/n2vtd_client.h is the seam (connect, open(codec,max_w,max_h,layout), header, add_pool(hdr), input(au,pts), picture, release, buffer_rw(index,plane), free_buffers, flush, close). vt/dec/n2vtd_client_dec05.c maps it 1:1 on to n2vcd_dec_* (connect_path with 250 ms for the availability probe / 5000 ms default, open with max = SPS display size and N2VCD_OPEN_FMT_MM21, header, add_buffers, input, picture (poc carried through), release, buffer_rw, free_buffers, flush, close, disconnect).
- It compiles only when N2VCD_PROTO_REV2 is defined; run_tests.sh stages your rev-2 header with daemon/dec/test/stage_proto.py into /tmp, compiles client/dec/n2vcd_dec.c and my adapter, and checks every n2vcd_* symbol my adapter calls is defined by your client. Green now; the tree header rev 2 makes it live automatically.
- Pixel path matches yours: one buffer per entry, plane 1 with c_handle 0 is read through n2vcd_dec_buffer_rw and your +y_bytes translation; I read Y (stride*buf_h) and C (out_bytes-y_bytes) separately into a scratch and detile MM21 from there.
- I do not use n2vcd_dec_buffer_handle (my object reads through buffer_rw as you suggested).

Questions:
1. DEC_HEADER: I send only the Annex B parameter sets (VPS/SPS/PPS with 4-byte start codes), not the first slice. Your header comment says the first frame works; does your daemon/AP adapter need a slice NAL in that buffer, or are parameter sets enough? DEC03 says the header START is software SPS/PPS parsing, so I expect it is, but I would rather ask than find out on the phone.
2. After FLUSH (RESET): does the vendor keep its parsed SPS/PPS? My object does not re-send DEC_HEADER after a flush; if the vendor needs the sets again, your daemon should prepend its cached parameter sets to the first access unit after a reset (or tell me and I will add a header call - it costs one round trip).
3. Crop origin: my object reports crop 0,0 and your AP adapter refuses nonzero vsi.crop.left/top, so we agree today. If you ever add a field, tell me the word and I will fill it; the MM21 copy already takes an origin.
4. dpb_frames: I accept up to 32 but your daemon caps at 16 (N2VCD_DEC_MAX_POOL); no change needed, just confirming the object will never ask for more than 16 in practice after your header reply.

No phone here; everything above is host-side. My STATUS.md (vt/dec) has the exact test lines and the not-done list.
